methodology.backend_cpu: FastAPI + symbolic_features on CI CPU; timed embed_composition_scope over embedding fixtures (N=50 warm iterations, report p50/p95 of last 40).
methodology.local_gpu_backend: No ROCm/CUDA device in CI harness → skipped_no_gpu; does not block ship.
methodology.browser_cpu: Node/Vitest timing of JS symbolic.features.v1 twin on same fixtures (handcrafted extract; no WebGPU).
methodology.browser_webgpu: Stubbed navigator.gpu harness for batched cosine WGSL over synthetic 81-D matrices (batch sizes 8/64/256); real Chromium WebGPU optional outside CI.
methodology.ship_rule: Implement WebGPU for a sub-path only if p50 WebGPU ≤ 0.85 × browser CPU for that sub-path, or it unlocks a workload impossible on CPU within the UX budget.
